name: @flowstarter/idea-validation
description: Phase 1 of the self-service pivot: a ReAct pipeline that researches a user's business idea and returns a corroborated go/no-go verdict (PMF, competitors, market signals). Ported from the ask-sage research engine — the deterministic corroboration core never fabricates a number. All LLM calls go through OpenRouter (hybrid routing); the seam is injectable so the whole loop runs with no network in tests.
